scripts.dev:express: supabase start && concurrently "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.dev: supabase start && concurrently "cd backend-go && go run main.go" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.migrate-dev: cp backend-go/migrations/*.sql supabase/migrations/ && supabase db reset
scripts.migrate-prod: cp backend-go/migrations/*.sql supabase/migrations/ && supabase db push
